posts.text:
Most enterprise cloud migrations stall not from containers or DBs, but because nobody designed landing zone governance on Day 1.

Automate policy guardrails with Terraform before granting developer access. Saves months of rework. #Azure

Balancing enterprise consulting while building a tech startup:

The key is zero context-switching during focus blocks.

Enterprise delivery builds discipline; startups demand speed. Both make you a sharper engineer. #BuildingInPublic

Managing IT for community non-profits reminds me that tech hygiene matters most where budgets are tightest.

Enforcing strict Entra ID MFA and domain security protects vulnerable community helplines from compromise. #Leadership

In enterprise consulting, the hardest problem is rarely technical architecture—it's organizational alignment.

A simple architecture with 100% buy-in beats a 'flawless' system that teams resist using every single time. #TechLead

Under Australia's Privacy Act APP 1.7–1.9, companies automating decisions affecting individuals must evidence how decisions were made.

Static PDF policies won't protect you in an OAIC audit. You need code-layer flight recorders. #RegTech

The biggest pitfall in enterprise RAG isn't the vector DB or embedding model—it's chunk boundary quality and metadata filtering.

Without document hierarchy and access scopes, your LLM retrieves garbage with high confidence. #AppliedAI

The secret to Platform Engineering:
Don't build an internal developer portal nobody asked for.

Find the 3 manual tickets filed every week (secret rotation, staging DB, preview envs) and automate them into a self-service CLI. #PlatformEngineering

CI/CD pipelines shouldn't just run unit tests; they should enforce architecture guardrails.

In our GitHub Actions, we reject PRs that introduce unpinned dependencies or drift from Bicep landing zone specs before code review starts. #DevOps
